note: CentiMark roofing service invoice -> commercial. Narrative anchor: asserts warranty '' on an invoice whose footer carries only past-due interest and collection-cost terms -- guards the warranty prompt's step 4 against reading payment/collection terms as a warranty. gst_amount 32.62 IS asserted from 2026-08-18 (A4/A3 fix); this note previously recorded it as KNOWN WRONG and predicted this change. This is a SECTIONED commercial bill with a GST row per line item (27.50 + 2.97 + 2.15 = 32.62 = 5% of the 652.30 subtotal, and 652.30 + 32.62 = the printed 684.92) and no TAX SUMMARY recap. The analyzer returned 27.50, the FIRST section's GST only, on 13 of 14 replicates. The sectioned-GST summation rescue was gated to the municipal bucket and so did not fire here; it now covers commercial too, guarded by the same 5% arithmetic identity rather than by the bucket, and gst_amount is 32.62 on all 14 replicates (amount_excluding_gst 652.30 with it). routingDecision is NO LONGER asserted: with the GST resolved the doc routes HAPPY_PATH_CANDIDATE on 13 of 14 runs and REVIEW_B4_CRITICAL_FIELD on the 14th, where CU itself returned 32.62 from the generate twin while the extract twin held 27.50 -- the twins disagree, so the field does not pass and a human looks. That is correct behaviour, but it makes the routing a genuine coin flip and therefore unassertable. Note the consequence: this document now auto-writes on 13 runs in 14, so the invoice_number defect below is no longer contained by review. || NOT asserted here: routingDecision (see above); diagnosis_solution, diagnosis_solution_zh_hant, recommendation_zh_hant -- free-text summaries that reword themselves across replicates (verified correct by eye on 3 runs: the leak was traced to a hole in the membrane and a temporary repair was made due to weather); recommendation (agreed on all 3 runs as 'Carry out permanent repair with EPDM kit.' and matches the Additional Work Recommended block, but free text agreeing over 3 runs is luck, not evidence -- excluded by the same standing rule as invoice_description); invoice_description (free text, excluded by standing rule). || invoice_number IS asserted from 2026-08-18 and this doc is the B5 anchor. The invoice line prints number and date together ('Invoice # / Date: 8001214179 - 01/14/2026') and the extract swallowed the date on about 1 replicate in 14, writing a date into the identifier column. That was tolerable only while this document always routed to review; fixing the sectioned GST above moved it to auto-write on 13 runs in 14, so build_write_values now trims a trailing date off the written identifier (field_policy.strip_trailing_date -- it requires the date's own punctuation, so dashed-numeric identifiers like '26-158696' and '2353671-0602-0' are untouched). 8001214179 on 14/14.
